verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
Lift up the trumpet, and loud let it ring: Jesus is coming again!
Cheer up, ye pilgrims, be joyful and sing: Jesus is coming again!
Coming again, coming again, Jesus is coming again!

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
Coming again, coming again,
Jesus is coming again!

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Echo it, hilltops; proclaim it, ye plains:
Jesus is coming again!
Coming in glory, the Lamb that was slain;
Jesus is coming again!

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Heavings of earth, tell the vast, wondering throng:
Jesus is coming again!
Tempests and whirlwinds, the anthem prolong;
Jesus is coming again!

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Nations are angry--by this we do know
Jesus is coming again!
Knowledge increases; men run to and fro;
Jesus is coming again!
